title: Indented code blocks are not supported
message: Quarto Markdown does not support 4-space indented code blocks. Use a fenced code block (```) instead, or remove the leading indentation.

cases.name: basic
cases.description: 4 leading spaces start a new block after a blank line

cases.name: tab-indent
cases.description: A single leading tab expands to 4 columns and triggers the same error

cases.name: more-than-four
cases.description: More than 4 leading spaces is the same error (CommonMark indented code is 4 or more)

cases.name: indented-blockquote
cases.description: Indented blockquote (CommonMark would treat the 4 spaces as opening an indented code block; Q2 rejects both)
